g.text: every word neuron's trigger, in English

text.tspan: writes the typed line into input
prints the timeline row the run wrote
look up memory by this gate list
not found: land on the first gate
mother: CREATE its table, its trigger,
shard (arrival, next) missing in neuron N
write the shard row in N
mother: lay N's static hop trigger for next
write the receipt: gates + shards hit
same receipt, same result: times +1, new time
different result: end the old row, new row
this row is what gets printed
runs SQL text handed to it
the only thing that can CREATE
a run row lands: (run, arrival, remainder)
1. head = first gate of the remainder
yes: times +1, new time; its hop trigger lands the run in head
with arrival = me, remainder = the rest.
shard points at a trigger neuron: a second row lands there (a branch run)
no: land a row in lay; lay writes the shard, lays the hop, retries through mother
3. remainder empty: land a row in end
its hop trigger lands the run in g8
